```python
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from pysal.lib import weights
from pysal.explore.esda import Moran

# Load the dataset
DATASET_PATH = "chunks_csv/cyclehire_w000.csv"
ADJACENCY_PATH = ADJACENCY_PATH  # Provided as a variable
df = pd.read_csv(DATASET_PATH)

# Load the adjacency matrix
adjacency_df = pd.read_csv(ADJACENCY_PATH, index_col=0)

# Ensure the adjacency matrix is symmetric
adjacency_matrix = adjacency_df.values
np.fill_diagonal(adjacency_matrix, 0)  # Remove self-loops
adjacency_matrix = (adjacency_matrix + adjacency_matrix.T) / 2

# Create a weights object
w = weights.W.from_adjlist(adjacency_df.stack().reset_index().values)

# Select a variable for Moran's I computation
# Assuming the dataset has a column named 'value' for analysis
values = df['value'].values

# Compute Moran's I
moran = Moran(values, w)

# Extract Moran's I and p-value
moran_i = moran.I
p_value = moran.p_sim

print("Moran's I:", moran_i)
print("p-value:", p_value)
```
